subject: northern pike
title: A Pike Hits 25 G When It Strikes. Ducks Aren't Safe

scenes.text: Ducks on this lake have a predator under the surface.
The northern pike can grow to almost five feet and hunts by ambush in weedy water.
It waits, perfectly still, then launches at around 12 G, peaking near 25 G.
A fighter pilot blacks out at about nine.
Hundreds of backward-pointing teeth mean nothing it grabs can pull free.
It eats fish, frogs, mice and even ducks. Prey up to a third of its own length.

description:
Northern pike reach up to about 1.5 m and are ambush predators. Fast-start studies (Harper and Blake, 1990) measured a mean maximum acceleration of about 120 m/s² (around 12 g), with a peak of about 245 m/s² (about 25 g).
Hundreds of backward-slanting teeth grip prey, which can include fish, frogs, rodents and waterfowl up to a third of the pike's length.
What's the scariest thing you've seen come out of a lake?
